notes: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, scraped from https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models on 2026-09-21 by scripts/capability-scrape.mjs. coding_score and general_score are that index rescaled so the snapshot's highest-scoring model (claude-fable-5-1, 53.35) is 100; the transform is monotonic in the published number and adds no per-model judgement.
